profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a passion for all things software and hardware.

Recent interest of mine is in embedded systems development, digital signal processing, and various machine learning techniques.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At InMobi I am responsible for primarily custom developments including internal tools and integrations. Additionally, I am responsible for any technical issues internal or external for brand side business in North America.

positions.title: Manager, Sales Engineer
positions.description: As a Sales Engineer at InMobi I was responsible for pre-sales and post-sales technical issues. For the first 6 months of my time at InMobi I was the only engineer serving all of North America business.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: At AdOptics we developed audio fingerprinting and recognition algorithms for the purpose of improving the accuracy and relevance of mobile advertising.

positions.title: Head of Product Integration
positions.description: Siber Systems develops both backup/synchronization and password management/form filler technologies that offer mature and stable functionality that has been utilized by several fortune 500 companies. It is my job to understand client needs, develop custom components, develop interfaces for 3rd party components, and offer my experience and knowledge of the technology to encourage a successful software integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Before joining Siber Systems, my primary focus in regards to programming was on personal projects of interest.  Now that I have joined Siber Systems, I have been able to provide input and use my knowledge to provide solutions to organizations around the world including Fortune 500 companies.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: At Blendfresh I was focused on providing elegant and interactive web interfaces supported and complimented by a functional and solid application back end. Having a passion for beautiful and intuitive experiences, I designed and developed interfaces and applications for several US based startups, small to medium sized businesses, and numerous U.K. based proprietorship's.

projects.title: ADS-B Free
projects.description: ADS-B Free is a cheap (less than $50 in hardware costs), open source ADS-B air traffic system designed to provide real time air traffic maps on iPad and Android devices. Typical tablet-based ADS-B solutions are in excess of $800+. Under development.

projects.title: HomeBase
projects.description: An open source ZigBee-based home automation system. Pluggable automated device system
